blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco and his wife, Rowena are currently out of the country, National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag confirmed on Tuesday. Matibag said this after Velasco’s former security aide, dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., appeared before the NBI on Monday for questioning regarding his allegations that he delivered more than P2 billion to Vice President Sara Duterte, P1 billion to former president Rodrigo Duterte, and P100 million to Davao City 1st District Rep. Paolo Duterte in tranches starting in 2018, at the former speaker’s instructions. READ: Ex-cop appears before NBI over […]... Keep on reading: NBI: Velasco, wife currently out of the country
